title: DAMPER: Return-Prioritized Gradient Control for Smooth Policies
abstract: arXiv:2609.38903v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Actor-critic methods achieve strong performance in continuous control, but their policies can produce highly oscillatory actions. A common remedy is to add auxiliary smoothness losses. However, their contribution can be negligible when their gradients are small relative to the native actor gradient. Moreover, existing methods often combine multiple auxiliary losses, complicating loss balancing without necessarily improving the return-smoothness trade-off. We introduce DAMPER (Direction-Aware Magnitude-Controlled Projection with Explicit Return Priority), which combines the native actor gradient with a temporal-consistency gradient through conflict-conditioned projection and adaptive magnitude control. It removes the auxiliary component opposing the actor gradient and scales the retained temporal direction relative to the actor gradient norm, preserving positive alignment with the native actor gradient. translated_title: DAMPER：面向平滑策略的回报优先梯度控制
translated_abstract: 演员-评论家方法在连续控制中表现出色，但其策略可能产生高度振荡的动作。一种常见的补救措施是添加辅助的平滑性损失。然而，当这些损失的梯度相对于演员原生梯度较小时，其贡献可能微不足道。此外，现有方法往往组合多个辅助损失，使损失平衡变得复杂，却不一定能改善回报与平滑性之间的权衡。我们提出了DAMPER（方向感知、幅度受控的投影与显式回报优先级），它通过冲突条件下的投影和自适应幅度控制，将演员原生梯度与时间一致性梯度相结合。该方法会移除与演员梯度方向相反的辅助分量，并根据演员梯度的范数对保留下来的时间一致性方向进行缩放，从而保持与演员原生梯度的正向对齐。在TD3和SAC上的实验（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DAMPER方法，通过冲突条件投影与自适应幅度控制将时间一致性梯度融入演员梯度，在不堆叠多个辅助损失的情况下优先保障回报并有效提升连续控制策略的平滑性。
en_tdlr: DAMPER combines the native actor gradient with a temporal-consistency gradient through conflict-conditioned projection and adaptive magnitude control, prioritizing return while improving policy smoothness without stacking multiple auxiliary losses.
